"""safh_decode.py FILE...: decode an FFXII TZA PC save container as the shipped code does (008666B0 / 00865D90 / 00865840):
'SAFH', u32 plain length, u32 rotation r (<= 31), body = RC4( zlib-compress(image) ) with the RC4 key = MD5 of the first 31 bytes
of the 32-byte constant at 01CCFCF8 rotated left by r (CryptDeriveKey CALG_RC4, 128-bit, no salt). Reports the checks only."""
import sys, struct, hashlib, zlib

CONST = b"FINAL FANTASY XII THE ZODIAC AGE"   # 01CCFCF8, 32 bytes


def rc4(key, data):
    S = list(range(256)); j = 0
    for i in range(256):
        j = (j + S[i] + key[i % len(key)]) & 0xFF
        S[i], S[j] = S[j], S[i]
    out = bytearray(len(data)); i = j = 0
    for n, c in enumerate(data):
        i = (i + 1) & 0xFF; j = (j + S[i]) & 0xFF
        S[i], S[j] = S[j], S[i]
        out[n] = c ^ S[(S[i] + S[j]) & 0xFF]
    return bytes(out)


def decode(buf, hashlen=31):
    assert buf[:4] == b"SAFH", "magic"
    plain_len, rot = struct.unpack_from("<II", buf, 4)
    rotated = CONST[rot:] + CONST[:rot]
    key = hashlib.md5(rotated[:hashlen]).digest()
    z = rc4(key, buf[12:])
    img = zlib.decompress(z)
    return plain_len, rot, z[:2], img


for p in sys.argv[1:]:
    b = open(p, "rb").read()
    try:
        n, r, zh, img = decode(b)
        print("%s rot=%d declared=%#x decoded=%#x match=%s zlib_hdr=%s img[0x60]=%#x" % (
            p.split("/")[-1], r, n, len(img), n == len(img), zh.hex(), struct.unpack_from("<I", img, 0x60)[0] if len(img) > 0x64 else -1))
    except Exception as e:
        # control: the 32-character variant must fail if the 31-byte reading is right
        try:
            decode(b, 32); print(p, "FAILED with 31 bytes but decodes with 32:", e)
        except Exception as e2:
            print(p, "FAILED both:", e, "/", e2)
